name: The Runed Scroll
summary: A silvery ribbon marks the Runed Scroll found in Kalimdor's wilds as a formal message from across the border. Finding it sends Horde scouts to the Mor'shan Rampart to warn its guards of activity to the north.

sections.title: A Silvery Ribbon
sections.body: A fine silvery ribbon binds the scroll, unlike the rough leathers and parchment common in the Barrens. Its craft and script point to the night elves beneath Ashenvale's canopies to the north. With every ridge and road contested, a message taken from the enemy could matter greatly to the Horde's front lines.

sections.title: Eyes on the Northern Border
sections.body: The scroll belongs with local command, not at the Warchief's hall in Orgrimmar. Kadrak, an orc warrior, watches the border from the Mor'shan Rampart, where the Barrens' red earth meets Ashenvale's forests. Bringing the scroll to this outpost gives its guards word of night elf troop movements.

faq.answer: The Runed Scroll is a finely made document bound with a silvery ribbon, and its form points to night elf origins. It carries intelligence about their movements or plans along the Barrens border.

faq.q: Where should I take the scroll?
aliases: where do i take the runed scroll
faq.answer: Take the scroll to Kadrak at the Mor'shan Rampart, the northern border post between the Barrens and Ashenvale.
Kadrak is a Horde scout and guard atop a defensive tower at the Mor'shan Rampart, where he watches for threats from Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why would the night elves drop a scroll in the Barrens?
faq.answer: Night elf sentinels and scouts patrol Ashenvale's borders and fringes, sometimes venturing south to test Horde defenses or ambush supply lines headed north.

faq.q: What happens after giving the scroll to Kadrak?
faq.answer: After reading the scroll, Kadrak names its author as Rynthariel, a dryad and Keymaster of the Talon Den. He sends you to Stonetalon Peak to kill her and plant a Horde flag in the den.

faq.q: Why does the scroll matter to the Horde?
faq.answer: Tensions between the Horde and night elves simmer over logging and borders. Intercepted messages can warn the Horde of Alliance ambushes against the Mor'shan Rampart.

angles.text: Each intercepted piece of Alliance intelligence helps protect the lumber crews and border sentries guarding the gateway into Ashenvale.
As an orc, you know the Warsong Clan's expansion into Ashenvale relies on the Mor'shan Rampart's defenses, so night elf messages carry vital news.
